task.title: Compose selected skills into durable cancellation tool turns
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/672 by retaining explicit skill composition and an exact caller-owned cancellation reason through bounded provider and tool continuations.
acceptance_criteria: Construct the caller cancellation and validate selected skills before durable, provider, authorization, or tool side effects.
Retain exact policy, selected skills, transcript, prior tool result, task identity, and TaskCancellation across opaque continuations.
Reject stale or terminal continuations before further work and require fresh permission for every tool invocation.
Commit final assistant content and an exact Attempt before cancelling with the retained reason without claiming in-flight interruption.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused cancellation integration test failed because cancellation-specific composed outcomes and runtime entrypoints were absent.
attempts.patch: Added tests for direct and continued cancellation, exact reason and authority retention, observation composition, persistence ordering, and selection, stale, and terminal rejection.

attempts.diagnostic: Cancellation-specific continuations retained validated caller intent while delegating provider and tool work to the established bounded attempt path and varying only final state application.
attempts.patch: Added cancellation outcomes and operations, a symmetric terminal helper, runtime and ADR documentation, complete integration coverage, and milestone status.

attempts.summary: Completed independent and substantive review without follow-up changes.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent pre-commit review found no blocking issue, the Rust gate passed on exact head, substantive review covered all five changed files, and no review threads remained.
attempts.patch: Preserved the minimal terminal conversion, explicit non-interruption contract, and completed ADR-0005 composition boundary.

outcome.summary: Durable composed cancellation turns now retain explicit skill authority and caller-owned reasons through bounded tool work before recording cancellation after final Attempt evidence.

lessons: A cancellation state transition records caller intent after bounded work; it does not interrupt an in-flight provider or tool call.
Provider output remains Attempt evidence and must never become the cancellation reason.
Typed continuations prevent caller-owned terminal intent from being lost or replaced between explicit steps.
The symmetric completion, failure, and cancellation flows stay simple when they share execution and vary only retained intent and finalization.
Completing an architecture decision should include executable coverage for every terminal path rather than relying on structural analogy.
